captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.aboutTheGame.des: Step into the future with "Book of Futuria," a thrilling slot game set in a tech-savvy Egypt! Dive into the excitement with awesome game features and uncover treasures using the epic "Book Bonus." Spin your way through a blend of ancient mystique and modern thrills – it's a clash of the past and future like never before!
captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.other.rules.desc: Prizes are awarded for matching combinations of symbols. Combinations must appear from left to right on a line, except for scatters. Only the highest win on each line and for each scatter combination is paid. Scatter wins and line wins are combined. The paytable displays prizes for the currently selected bet amount. Book Scatter symbols can substitute any paying symbol during the game
captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.cards.descriptio:
3 or more book scatters on the screen trigger 10 free games with a special expanding symbol. The special expanding symbol cannot be substituted by a scatter symbol during Free games.
One special expanding symbol is randomly selected at the start of the Free games. During Free Games and after the payout of regular symbols, the special symbol may expand to cover 3 positions on the reel and pays like the regular symbol, even on non-adjacent positions and on all lines played (expanding is only triggered if enough symbols for a win are present).
Every time a player hits 3 or more Book scatter symbols during Free games, they will win an extra 10 Free spins, and the expanding bonus symbol will remain the same.
Players can use the Buy Bonus Feature to buy the Free Games Round at a specified price.
captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.feature.descript: Activate or deactivate the Bonus Bet feature using the B+ button in the game lobby. Enabling this feature incurs an additional cost of 25% of the total bet. Note that the added B+ value does not impact symbol payouts in both the basic and bonus games.
captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.feature2.descrip: The B+ feature lets players accumulate scatters exclusively during the base game. Upon collecting 100 scatters at a specific bet amount, players automatically trigger a free bonus game. The B+ feature also introduces the "Bonus Gamble" option. When the B+ Progress Bar reaches 10%, players can engage in the Gamble game. The outcome, whether a win or lose, is determined by the progress bar percentage
captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.after.bonus.desc: During the Bonus Risk game, a wheel appears on the screen. Spinning the wheel can result in either a winning green sector, awarding a Free Bonus Game, or a losing red sector, leading players back to the base game. Regardless of the outcome, the progress bar is reset after each Bonus Risk game spin.
captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.bonus.descriptio:
The cost of a Bonus Risk game spin aligns with the bet amount used to accumulate Progress Bar percentages. If a player lacks sufficient funds, an error pop-up prompts them to add funds. Losing in the Bonus Risk game grants an extra spin in the base game, while winning rewards players with a bonus-winning spin.

If a player lands 3 or more Scatters during the base game, and the B+ Progress Bar reaches 100%, they enter two consecutive bonus games. The first starts automatically, followed by the second.
Bonus Buy Feature Discount:
Players starting Progress Bar progress on a specific bet limit may purchase the Bonus feature at a discounted rate corresponding to the indicated percentage on the progress bar. For instance, if the Bonus feature costs 100% of the bet and a player accumulates 1% on the B+ progress bar at the same bet level, they can purchase the bonus with a 1% discount, reducing the price to 99% of the bet size.
captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.x2.description:
In Book of Futuria , players have the opportunity to double their winnings with the X2 Gamble Feature. After a winning spin, players can access the Gamble round by clicking the "X2" button. Once the gamble screen appears, a card in the middle of the screen will flash red and black while face down, indicating that the gamble feature is active.
To double their winnings, players must correctly guess the color of the card that will be revealed next. If they succeed, their winnings will be doubled. However, if they guess incorrectly, their original win will be lost. At any point, players can use the "Take Win" button to collect their winnings and add them to their main balance.
captions.help.slot.bookoffuturia.chooseBet.descri: Change bet value and open the bet menu, select the bet you want to use in the game.
In the event of a disconnection during gameplay, all accepted bets will still be played out, and any resulting wins will be credited to the player's balance at the end of the round. Please note that after a disconnection, Autoplay mode will be switched off to ensure a fair and enjoyable gaming experience.
It's important to note that any malfunction will void all plays and payouts, and any unfinished round will be terminated.
When you hit a winning combination, you have three options to credit the win amount to your balance: you can start a new spin by clicking the spin button, use the Take Win button to transfer the win to your balance, or use the X2 Double Up feature button and click Take Win.
If you are playing in Autoplay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.
